→黒猫、首輪無し、短めのカギ尻尾、金と緑の中間（もしくはグラデーション）の瞳

Hi! Nice to meet you. I really like your beautiful illustrations and would like to make a request.

 ■ Female: Lari. 19 years old. Lari is a sweet, elegant young lady. She has a calm, warm, and bright personality. She bickers and argues with Rupe often, but the two are very much a sweet, loving couple. She loves flowers and gardens. 

 ■ The setting of their world is a "old-fashioned, victorian european town with princes and princesses". Both of them are nobles. The both of them had dark pasts with complicated family situations, with a lot of despair. Their dating phase was very complicated and full of turmoil and despair, but they finally reached their fairy-tale like happy ending.

 ■ The two often spend time together drinking tea at cafe, spending time reading at the library, hanging out in the forest nearby or the gardens of their home, reading books outside in the flower fields and river, watching the sunrise, sunset, watching the stars... spending time at a tea shop eating desserts, walking around the downtown food markets. The composition and pose is up to you. Pleae design freely!

I will be grateful if you consider this request.
